issues.description: Function construct_zero_state_prep_circuit: the template, problem statement, and solution disagree on the return type. The problem statement declares construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int=0) -> stim.Circuit (expects a Stim circuit to be returned). The solution implements def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(... ) -> stim.Circuit and returns a stim.Circuit. The template declares def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(... ) -> None, which implies no return value. This mismatch is likely to confuse students about whether they should return a stim.Circuit or mutate an existing circuit in-place, and will break static type checks or any tests that expect a returned stim.Circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to match the problem statement and solution: def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int = 0) -> stim.Circuit:. Update the template docstring to state that a stim.Circuit is returned and ensure the function returns a stim.Circuit instance (or clearly documents in-place behavior if returning None is intentional). This keeps type hints, tests, and student expectations consistent.

issues.description: Function return-role mismatch for the logical-zero state preparer: the problem statement specifies a function named construct_zero_state_prep_circuit that returns a stim.Circuit (signature: construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int=0) -> stim.Circuit). The template repository declares def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) -> None (implying no return / in-place behavior). The solution repository implements and returns a stim.Circuit (def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) -> stim.Circuit and returns the constructed circuit). This inconsistent return annotation/behavior across artifacts can confuse students whether they should return a new Stim circuit or append to an existing one in-place, blocking correct implementation and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution: change the template function signature to def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int = 0) -> stim.Circuit, update the docstring to state that the function returns a stim.Circuit, and implement (or instruct students to implement) returning the constructed stim.Circuit. Alternatively (less preferred), update the problem statement and solution to clearly document an in-place API — but keep all three artifacts consistent.
